content.short: Cryptofonts accelerates app development with crypto APIs and design tools.
content.description: Cryptofonts is the largest open-source icon library, offering more than 1500 CSS and SVG icons, including fonts and crypto brands. All assets are available without signup, making it easy to browse and implement from the start. The project also provides an API to fetch token information, enabling developers to programmatically access token data and empowering designers with a broad set of SVG token icons. Together, these features make Cryptofonts a foundational resource for crypto development and design.
content.meta: Cryptofonts is the largest open-source library with 1500+ CSS/SVG icons, fonts and crypto brands. Discover Cryptofonts and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
